paragraphs.text: A ferry has crossed the strait since 1887. Since the bridge opened in 2003, it has carried far fewer cars, but numbers of foot passengers have risen, mostly tourists who want the view.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The service is now run by a company owned by the two towns on either side. It receives no money from the region, and the timetable is shorter in winter, when the crossing is often rough.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: The ferry stopped running when the bridge opened.
More people now cross on foot than before 2003.
The region gives money to the ferry service.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
